parsed.reason: Written in Chinese, the reply says the Gymnastics Tots ask is off and offers to queue for the Saturday 9:30 Little Kickers class at the Dec 1, 7am open. It does not claim any registration and gives no other session or time. Two small weaknesses: '已经取消了' could be misread as a registration having been cancelled, and asking which time slots to rank is somewhat redundant since the parent already named the 9:30 class. Still a pass.
